verdict.rationale: Official docs show plugins can be managed from the Codex CLI. There is a `codex plugin marketplace add` subcommand for adding and tracking marketplace sources, `/plugins` opens a plugin browser inside Codex CLI, and `/skills` and `$skill-installer` cover skill discovery and installation from the CLI. Missing for 10: a full CLI command reference beyond these few commands (e.g., install/remove/list subcommands), scripting or non-interactive usage details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the plugin CLI workflow.
